finding.title: Integer overflow in dup_n length calculation
finding.description: dup_n copies the first n bytes of src into a freshly allocated buffer. The size is computed as `unsigned short total = n + 1`, which wraps to 0 when n is 65535, so malloc allocates far fewer bytes than the following memcpy of n bytes writes. The caller controls only the length n (an unsigned short). A benign in-range length must return a correctly sized, NUL-terminated buffer.
